name: George Frazier
bio: George Frazier has served in information technology and information security leadership roles for over 25 years. He is currently an information security manager at Rowan University focusing on vulnerability management and incident response. He holds a M.Ed. in Computers and Technology in Education. George Frazier holds the following certifications in information security: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC System and Network Auditor (GSNA), and GIAC Security Leadership Certification (GSLC). Before starting his career in information technology and information security, George Frazier served in the United States Marine Corps achieving the rank of Major.
